headline: NBP halts TK transfers. Minister responds
summary: The National Bank of Poland has suspended transfers to the Constitutional Tribunal. Finance Minister Andrzej Domański said analyses of funding options are under way and will comply with the law.
why: The National Bank of Poland is the country's central bank, and its funding decisions for state bodies can affect public finances and investor confidence.
original_headline: NBP wstrzymał przelewy TK. Minister reaguje
